item174.requirement: Preserve locks, selected repair scope and member preferences across responsive reflow and recoverable frontend errors.
item174.acceptance_scope: Generation locks, repair selection and member preference controls
pass_conditions: Set nondefault locks, repair scope and preferences; resize through mobile and desktop layouts and verify the selections remain identical.
Inject a recoverable frontend failure and recover without resetting those choices or changing the eventual request payload.
evidence_needed: Recorded control values and request payloads before/after resize and recovery.
Evidence must identify the relevant source/build and the covered fixture, role, state and environment; retain untested portions explicitly.
item174.remaining_gap: Completion is unassessed here: inspect the candidate contents and snapshot coverage for generation locks, repair selection and member preference controls, then supply missing evidence against each pass condition.

decision: Partial/unproven against exact item174 criteria. Existing source appears designed to retain selections; no current runtime defect demonstrated. Strongest next action is focused current-source resize+recoverable-error+exact-request test, not a speculative code change.

actual_controls.behavior: Actual enabled launcher imports openIntelligentRota for captured rotaTemplateMonth; requires draft template with slots.

actual_controls.state: mode and seconds closure variables; render reads them; eventual jobs body includes both.

Two closure Sets. Checking lock removes same slot from repairs; checking repair removes same slot from locks. Only slots with exactly one assigned person render repair checkbox; repair checkboxes disabled outside repair mode. These are deliberate mutual-exclusion semantics, not state-loss defects.

actual_controls.scope: Member preference list and unsent preference row
actual_controls.state: Accepted local Add appends preferences array. Current unsent dropdown selection stored in preferenceDraft and restored after render. Jobs request includes committed preferences array, not unadded preferenceDraft.

retention_source_evidence.observation: rota-intelligence.ts has no resize handler that replaces closure state. Shared workspaceDialog handles window/visualViewport resize through fitViewport; controls should persist on CSS/geometry reflow. This is source support, not an actual before/after resize record.

render checks Sets to render checked state, restores preferenceDraft dropdowns, retains mode/seconds and preferences count. Tab navigation and lock/repair actions call render; selections remain closure-owned.

action(work) catch displays notice, attempts GET job refresh if job exists, then finally busy=false;render(). It does not clear repairs/locks/preferences/preferenceDraft. A capabilities GET503 before creating any job is a particularly clean read-only failure to verify retention without uncertain mutation.

Generate reads closures into POST rota-intelligence/jobs: {month,mode,seconds,engine,repair_slots:mode===repair?[...repairs]:[],locked_slots:[...locks],preferences}. Exact array membership/order must be recorded after resize and recovery; compare same selections in successful baseline and failed-then-recovered scenario.

Conflict handoff showProposalConflict retry reopens a new workspace, so closure state is not guaranteed across conflict/reopen. Initial setup failure occurs before choices can be set. Closing/discarding intentionally ends workspace. Do not treat those as the ordinary recoverable-in-place error scenario without separately defining expected behavior.

historical_evidence.reported_scope: Actual source modules with intercepted requests; synthetic beforeunload tests predicate only. No native exit or physical-device claim.

historical_coverage_assessment: qa-intelligence-drafts36 covers fixed width320/1280 contexts, tab draft retention, close/Escape/unload predicate, teaching/calendar accepted/read failure, pending request lifetime and Apply clean baseline. It does not set nondefault locks or repairs, never resizes an already configured dialog, and never records intelligent jobs create payload after that sequence.

Its historical rota-intelligence source ab015591 differs from current bda7257a; workspace-load-state also differs. It cannot directly certify current174 without exact source applicability or fresh execution. frontend-runtime remains equal in the inspected hash.

qa-generation-actions-current includes configuration checkbox mutual exclusion and adding one default preference, plus unrelated assistant failure retry and other stages. It does not show selected lock AND a different selected repair slot surviving actual viewport transition and error, nor a jobs request body with those nondefaults. No top-level source hash binding found in that report.
Fixed mobile and desktop cases are not the same as responsive reflow of one configured open dialog. Synthetic beforeunload only tests guard predicate, not physical browser exit.

strongest_next_actual_test.failure_classification: 503 here is recoverable transport/read failure displayed by frontend, not a thrown DOM rendering exception. If criterion demands an actual frontend exception too, separately inject prepareEngine rejection through supported failure fixture or a single controlled callback exception with documented exact location; do not call network503 proof of all frontend exceptions.
strongest_next_actual_test.evidence: Fresh held source/build hashes, raw request logs including failed capability GET and single successful intelligent create, before/after control snapshots at every viewport and recovery step, no mutation replay or Apply, errors list, exact test source. Do not reset acceptance or mutate backend.
